app.title: Any window from your Mac, on your iPhone and iPad
app.author: chanana
app.description: A cross‑platform CLI that streams macOS windows to iPhone/iPad screens, enabling remote viewing.
proposed_tests: Install the tool via Homebrew or pip and run `sill --help`
Launch a sample macOS application window, run `sill stream <window-id>`
Verify the stream appears on an iOS simulator or device
Measure latency between input on iOS and output on macOS
